translated_text: GRAND CAFÉ DE LA BOURSE ET DU COMMERCE L. BOUSQUET RC PÉRIGUEUX 6500 PÉRIGUEUX (DORDOGNE) Telephone 23 23 6 Périgueux, 1940 My dear wife, I sent you a telegram today. I hope you received it. It's of no importance, only because you haven't heard from me in a long time, perhaps you haven't received any letters for a long time either. It's not certain, but I wanted to prepare you for that eventuality. I don't know anything at the moment. Perhaps we will have a reasonable peace in a few days. Once again, pray for me. I am very well, don't worry about me. Unfortunately, it is impossible to go to Riguriac. I think he's the best. You stay where you are (in any case, naturally, if the family leaves, you must go with them. But never alone, my little one. You heard! I hope I can give you my address soon. For the moment, I can't receive letters from you. Despite everything, I hope all is well and I think you will receive the happiness I have today from you. I would be so happy. I don't know how long I'll stay here. Maybe 3 days. Maybe I'll leave tonight. Naturally, I will write to you every day if possible. You give me a lot of strength, my little one, if we stay calm. The strength I need to see you again soon. I feel us. I only ever think of my brave little wife. You must stay with me like this to find a new life. I kiss you a thousand times and I hope your Bob. See you soon. I kiss the whole family. PE JEUX 15 *> 23 - VI 1940 GRAND CAFÉ OF THE EXCHANGE AND COMMERCE L. BOUSQUET TELEPHONE 23 DORDOGNE PÉRIGUEUX (DORDOGNE) Mrs. T POSTS VISIT PERIGUEUX GALLO-ROMAN RUINS REPUBLIC CA BASILICA SAINT FRONT RENAISSANCE HOUSES E.
